An '''ion wave''' was a circular disc ray that was omitted by an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. It was capable of turning off all electrical devices, including [[Life support/Legends|life support]], leaving [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] defenseless.
